response.original_title: 【2026 FAQS Guide】How do I add a room on a Disney Cruise?
response.overview: To add a room to your Disney Cruise booking, please contact Disney Cruise Line Customer Service at  +1(888).315-9585 (US) or  +1(888).315-9585 (US) &  +1(888).315-9585 (UK). A customer service representative can help you check available staterooms and guide you through  +1(888).315-9585 (US) adding one to your existing reservation. Please have your booking details ready when you call. Room availability and pricing may vary depending on your cruise and sailing date.
